rv.q: The best new comedy to open straight onto the West End in decades.
This lung-bustingly funny play is just what the therapist ordered.
It’s the funniest play since Noises Off .
If you’re looking for a West End comedy where big laughs are guaranteed then this is the show for you.

cn.t: Mischief Theatre delivers a thrillingly inventive farce with manic energy, combining sharp wordplay and daring physical comedy. Critics hail it as lung-bustingly funny and the best new West End comedy in decades.
